TestPutGet::test_putget.description: 3-node cluster (3 racks), RF=3, uncompressed table (compression={}). tools.data.putget writes one partition with 100 cells, then overwrites 50 and 20 of them, flushing between each batch so reads merge 3 sstables; SELECT at QUORUM asserts 100 rows with the newest values. Generic multi-sstable merge/overwrite read correctness.
